implemented_capabilities.capability: Transitive vulnerability blast radius over a dependency graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameterized Cypher MATCH p=(Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(Package)-[:USES_VERSION]->(PackageVersion)<-[:AFFECTS]-(Vulnerability {id:$id}) with OPTIONAL MATCH to Application and Team; returns service, hops and full node-id path. Depth capped at 6; FalkorDB paths do not repeat edges so cycles are bounded (tested on a cyclic fixture).

Each candidate is checked for COMPATIBILITY_BLOCK (BLOCKS edges), RESIDUAL_VULNERABLE_SERVICES (scope vs affected set) and OWNER_EVIDENCE_MISSING; selects min over (violations, residual, breaking_risk, cost_proxy) among safe plans, otherwise ABSTAIN. Counterfactual is a deterministic projection that never mutates the source graph. Pure rule engine; no LLM in the decision.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Hash-based audit receipts and replay reproducibility
implemented_capabilities.notes: Every graph tool call records its input and sha256 of its rows; the receipt (decision, selected candidate, analysis_hash, tool call hashes, receipt_hash) is stored as a Decision node with DECIDED_FROM and SUPPORTED_BY edges. /api/replay re-runs the analysis and compares analysis_hash to detect non-reproducible results. Decisions are append-only within a fixture run.

The 11-step 'agent' (OBSERVE ... PERSIST_DECISION) is a labelled trace of the deterministic engine calls; each step is marked VERIFIED by construction. Optional local Ollama (qwen3:8b) tool-calling proof exists in scripts/ai_agent_proof.py only and cannot choose safety. The code itself states it is not an LLM-autonomy claim.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Allowlisted fixture loader and public-demo guards
implemented_capabilities.notes: Labels/relationship types validated against allowlists before being interpolated into CREATE statements; graph name regex-validated; 16 KB body cap, 90 req/min per-IP in-memory rate limit, security headers.

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph '<prefix>_demo'. Labels: Repository, Application, Service, Package, PackageVersion, Vulnerability{severity,advisory_range,synthetic}, Team, RemediationCandidate{kind,target_version,scope,cost_proxy,breaking_risk}, Decision{receipt_hash,decision,payload}, Evidence. Edges: DEPENDS_ON, USES_VERSION, AFFECTS, RUNS, OWNED_BY, INTRODUCES, PATCHES, BLOCKS, MITIGATES, SUPPORTED_BY, DECIDED_FROM. Plain openCypher (variable-length path, OPTIONAL MATCH, collect, list comprehension); no APOC/GDS/algo procedures. All runtime values are bound parameters; the only f-string Cypher interpolates allowlisted label/relationship names. Writes use graph.query; reads also use graph.query (not ro_query).
algorithms: Depth-capped (1..6) variable-length path enumeration with path-id evidence (engine.py:trace_dependency_paths)
Lexicographic score tuple selection (violations, residual services, breaking_risk, cost) among constraint-safe plans (engine.py:choose_plan)
Deterministic counterfactual projection of residual risk (engine.py:simulate_counterfactual)
Canonical-JSON sha256 receipts and replay comparison (engine.py:stable_hash, persist_audit_receipt)
frontend_interfaces: Vanilla JS/HTML/CSS single page (frontend/index.html, app.js, styles.css, v2/v3.css) with graph view and remediation cards
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Explicit step-list agent over deterministic graph tools with an abstain outcome; decision memory is the Decision node plus receipt hash within the demo graph (graph is ephemeral and reset on scenario load). No cross-session memory or learning.
tests_present: tests/test_integration.py: 5 test functions (one parametrized over 4 gold scenarios, so about 8 cases) covering gold blast radius/plan selection, unsafe upgrade rejection plus receipt replay equality, unknown-vulnerability abstention, cycle boundedness/partial-plan rejection, API readiness and request-size guard. All require a live FalkorDB. scripts/evaluate.py + artifacts/evaluation.json report 4/4 scenarios correct versus a direct-dependency baseline (synthetic fixtures authored with the gold answers).
security_findings: src/patchpath/api.py:~97-103 and ~108-114 - POST /api/reset and /api/scenarios/{id}/load wipe and reload the shared graph (MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n in graph.py:~42) with no authentication; acceptable for an ephemeral synthetic demo, not for a shared Kairos graph
src/patchpath/api.py - single global state dict (scenario_id, analysis) guarded by a process-local Lock; not multi-tenant or multi-worker safe
src/patchpath/api.py:~34-36,~64-72 - per-IP rate limiter is an in-memory dict keyed on request.client.host (spoofable behind proxies, unbounded key growth)
src/patchpath/graph.py:~54-66 - f-string Cypher with label/rel type, but both validated against fixed allowlists first (safe)
scripts/render_supervisor.py:62,83 - subprocess.Popen with list args launching redis/uvicorn for the Render deployment; deployment-only
scripts/ai_agent_proof.py:44 - urlopen to a local Ollama URL; dev proof script only
No eval/exec/pickle; no hard-coded secrets (env-driven PATCHPATH_FALKOR_* settings)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Same sweep contains MaybeSomeone-arc18/patchpath and HusseinAdeiza/graphhacks-patchweaver (same family: dependency blast radius + remediation). Overlaps blast-radius traversal (AgentAhmed/blast-radius, ProthamD/graph-hacks) and Security & Vulnerability remediation-path repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - audit receipts with canonical sha256 of every tool result, replay-based drift detection (analysis_hash mismatch), Evidence-backed candidates, OWNER_EVIDENCE_MISSING constraint and abstention are directly reusable for decision lineage; no supersession, temporal validity or human approval gate.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: About 200 lines of deterministic, parameterized FalkorDB-1.8-compatible logic: transitive impact paths, constraint-violating-candidate rejection, abstain-on-no-safe-plan, and a replayable hashed Decision receipt.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB server (4.x) only; no LLM required

strategy_rationale: A small, MIT-licensed, tested engine whose blast-radius + constraint + hashed-receipt pattern slots directly into Kairos dependency invalidation and decision lineage on FalkorDB; take engine.py/graph.py and the receipt scheme, and treat the 11-step agent wrapper as presentation.
